en: Before the world began, she was already there.
hi: दुनिया बनने से पहले भी, वो वहाँ थीं।
mr: जग बनण्याच्या आधीसुद्धा, ती तिथे होती.
note: All three already fit; copied unchanged.

en: Her sword cuts our chains. Her open hand sets us free.
hi: उनकी तलवार हमारे बंधन काटे। खुला हाथ हमें आज़ाद करे।
mr: तिची तलवार बेड्या तोडे. उघडा हात सोडवी.
note: hi and mr shortened; en unchanged; mr drops 'her' from the open-hand clause and uses सोडवी (free) to fit.
en and hi shortened; mr keeps dawn and sages, 'asking' cut to fit.
Both questions kept in short form; 'please tell' dropped.
'Listen' cut in en and mr; 'first' kept; mr uses सांगे to fit.

en: Brahma made the gods, the sages and Daksha. Then, from his deep thought, a daughter was born.
hi: ब्रह्मा जी ने देवता, ऋषि और दक्ष बनाए। फिर उनके ध्यान से एक बेटी जन्मी।
mr: ब्रह्मदेवांनी देव, ऋषी आणि दक्ष घडवले. मग ध्यानातून एक मुलगी जन्मली.
note: mr drops 'त्यांच्या' (his) to fit; en and hi unchanged.

en: Then another from his mind, yellow as gold.
hi: उनके मन से एक और जन्मा, सोने-सा पीला।
note: en keeps 'another' and 'yellow as gold'; hi drops 'फिर'; mr drops 'his' and 'पिवळा', gold kept as सोनेरी.

en: Lord, what's my work? Give me a home and wife.
hi: प्रभु, काम क्या? घर, पत्नी दें।
mr: प्रभू, काम काय? घर, बायको द्या.
note: hi and mr keep work, home and wife; en unchanged.
The verb 'named' is dropped to fit; the three names are kept as given.

en: Flower arrows win hearts, even Shiva.
note: 'every' dropped in en and hi to fit; flower arrows, winning hearts and even Shiva kept.

en: He aimed at Brahma's court. Every mind slipped.
hi: उसने ब्रह्मा-सभा पर बाण मारा। सबका मन डोला।
note: en drops 'own'; hi writes 'ब्रह्मा-सभा'; mr drops the aim verb to fit.
Short question kept in all three; 'it's' dropped.

en: Brahma and sages bowed in shame.
hi: ब्रह्मा जी और मुनि शर्म से झुक गए।
note: en and mr shortened; hi unchanged (already fits).

en: Brahma, she's your own daughter. Why?
hi: ब्रह्मा जी, आपकी बेटी है। मन डोला?
note: Approved 'your own daughter' kept; second question cut to 'Why?' / 'मन डोला?' / 'का?'.
en uses 'trembled' for 'began to shake'; hi unchanged; mr uses कंपले to fit.

en: You shot me? Mahadeva's eye-fire'll burn you.
hi: बाण? महादेव की आँख-आग तुम्हें जलेगी।
note: NOT FIT (hi over by 6): en contracts 'will' to 'll'; mr drops 'माझ्यावर'; hi cannot keep eye-fire and the question within 30.
en drops 'ever' to fit; hi uses 'हटाएँगे' (remove) for take back; mr uses 'ते' (he) for Brahma.

en: You said aim at everyone. Blame me?
hi: आपने कहा सब पर चलाओ। दोष?
note: 'Why' dropped; 'you said aim at everyone' and the blame question kept.
